ResearchProjectDef.label: storm protection
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grounding spires, circuit breakers, and hardened conduits to protect a power grid from lightning strikes and short circuits.

ResearchProjectDef.label: flare shielding
ResearchProjectDef.description: Field generators that deflect solar flare radiation and dampen electromagnetic pulses, keeping electronics alive through the worst the sky can deliver.

ResearchProjectDef.label: atmospheric control
ResearchProjectDef.description: Ionospheric agitation techniques that let a colony summon a thunderstorm on demand. Warning: side effects include dramatic weather, well-fed storm spires, and smug colonists.

ResearchProjectDef.label: perfect grounding
ResearchProjectDef.description: Superconducting earth anchors and self-balancing load regulators that let a storm spire dump an entire lightning strike into the grid without a single stray surge. Eliminates the risk of "Zzzt!" power surges from grid-connected storm spires.
